dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: I collect minimal information to provide our service:
dataCollection.email: Email address (for account recovery and notifications)
dataCollection.ipAddresses: IP addresses (in server logs for security and spam prevention, retained for 90 days)
dataCollection.oauthData: OAuth provider IDs (if you use Google Sign-In)
dataCollection.legalBasis: Legal bases: Contract performance (providing the service), Legitimate interest (security, fraud prevention).

rights.title: Your Rights (GDPR)
rights.content: Under EU law, you have the following rights regarding your data:
rights.access: Right to access: request a copy of your data (email {email})
rights.rectification: Right to rectification: update your username and email in your account settings
rights.deletion: Right to erasure: delete your account and all personal data (email {email} to request account deletion)
rights.portability: Right to portability: export your data in JSON format (email {email})
rights.howTo: To exercise these rights, contact me at {email}. I will respond within 30 days.
rights.note: Note: When you delete your account, your personal information (email, username) is removed, but your contributions (projects, images) are anonymized and may remain publicly visible.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: I use the following external services:
thirdParty.google: Optional sign-in method. Shares your email and name with us.
thirdParty.cloudflare: Hosting and CDN. May process IP addresses.
thirdParty.aws: Email delivery. Processes email addresses for account emails.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content: I retain your data as follows:
retention.account: Account data (email, username, password): Until you delete your account
retention.logs: Server logs (IP addresses): Automatically deleted after 90 days
retention.sessions: Session cookies: Expire after 30 days of inactivity
retention.contributions: Contributions (projects, images): Anonymized when you delete your account, but may remain publicly visible
retention.deletion: When you delete your account, all personal data is permanently removed within 30 days.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.sessionCookie: Session cookie: Keeps you logged in (expires after 30 days of inactivity)
cookies.purpose: This cookie is strictly necessary for authentication and does not require consent.
cookies.noTracking: I do not use any tracking, analytics, or advertising cookies.

userContent.moderation: I may remove content that violates our guidelines without notice
